# Migration guide

Every breaking change per major release, newest first: what to look for (before), what to write (after), why, and whether `bunx @codeatlasdev/ui migrate --from <major> --to <major> --write` covers it. `yes` is rewritten, `partial` is rewritten where it is static and reported (file:line) where it is not, `no` is yours to do. The same data is in `dist/migrations.json` and the MCP tool `get_migration`.

## 4.0.0

Main landmark in AppShellLayout, one selectable opt-out class.

### `v4-appshell-main-landmark`

- **Before** (behavior): <main> inside <AppShellLayout> content
- **After**: remove your <main>, or pass mainId={null}
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: `AppShellLayout` renders its content region as `<main id="main" tabindex="-1">`. A page that already wraps its content in `<main>` now has two landmarks: remove yours or pass `mainId={null}` (the region becomes a plain div).

### `v4-selectable-class`

- **Before** (renamed): .selectable
- **After**: .ca-selectable
- **migrate**: yes (`selectable-to-ca-selectable`)
- **Why / notes**: `nativeFeel()` has one opt-out class for the context menu and text selection. `.selectable` only existed in a JSDoc line; until it is renamed, right-click on that region is blocked. The codemod renames `class="selectable"` and `class:selectable` in markup.

## 3.0.0

Sober default theme, surface engine, layout primitives, unified layers.

### `v3-liquid-glass-opt-in`

- **Before** (behavior): default theme (glass, mesh, glow, 10px controls, 700 headings)
- **After**: designStyle("liquid", { ...yourTheme }) from @codeatlasdev/ui/vite
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: The default is solid and neutral. To keep the old look use `designStyle("liquid")` or set defaultStyle "glass", paper "mesh", radius 1, iconStroke 2 and heading weight 700. Apps that override `--ca-*` tokens are unaffected; apps that read `--ca-radius-*` or the shadow tokens get the new values.

### `v3-grid-columns`

- **Before** (renamed): <Grid cols={n}>, rowGap, colGap, template strings
- **After**: <Grid columns={n} gap="4"> (1-12 or responsive); grid-template-columns in a class
- **migrate**: partial (`layout-primitives`)
- **Why / notes**: `cols` becomes `columns`. `rowGap`, `colGap` and CSS template strings (`2fr 1fr`) are gone and are reported for you to write in a class.

### `v3-gap-step-scale`

- **Before** (behavior): <Stack gap={16}>, <Grid gap={16}>, align/justify values
- **After**: gap="4" (px / 4), align start|center|end|stretch|baseline, justify start|center|end|between|around|evenly
- **migrate**: partial (`layout-primitives`)
- **Why / notes**: `gap` is a spacing step string, not pixels: an untouched `gap={16}` would silently become step 16. Static values on the scale are converted; dynamic or off-scale ones are reported.

### `v3-glasscard-to-card`

- **Before** (renamed): <GlassCard thickness tinted glowing padding>
- **After**: <Card material="glass" elevation tone="brand" glow p>
- **migrate**: yes (`layout-primitives`)
- **Why / notes**: Deprecated in 3.0.0 (dev warning) and kept as a wrapper. `thickness` maps to `elevation` (thin 2, regular 3, thick 4); the default regular is written as elevation 3 so the fill, blur and rim stay. Dynamic props are left with their import.

### `v3-glasssurface-to-surface`

- **Before** (renamed): <GlassSurface thickness refraction tinted glowing>
- **After**: <Surface material="liquid" | "glass" elevation tone glow>
- **migrate**: yes (`layout-primitives`)
- **Why / notes**: `refraction` maps to material liquid (true) or glass (false).

### `v3-row-to-flex`

- **Before** (renamed): <Row gap={8} align="center">
- **After**: <Flex gap="2" align="center">
- **migrate**: yes (`layout-primitives`)
- **Why / notes**: `Row` used to default to flex-start alignment; `Flex` leaves it to the browser (stretch), so a Row without `align` may need `align="start"`.

### `v3-unified-layer-engine`

- **Before** (behavior): .ca-floating wrapper div, .ca-date__float, --ca-z-dropdown / --ca-z-tooltip on overlays
- **After**: .ca-floating on the layer element itself; the top layer orders overlays
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: Overlays live in the top layer, so stacking no longer depends on z-index. The wrapper div is gone and `.ca-date__float` was removed; the z tokens remain for your own in-flow UI.

## 2.0.0

bits-ui removed, native dialogs.

### `v2-modal-overlay-dialog`

- **Before** (behavior): .ca-overlay (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Drawer, Lightbox, CommandPalette, DocsSearch)
- **After**: dialog.ca-overlay::backdrop for the scrim; .ca-overlay is the <dialog> itself
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: A modal is one native <dialog> moved to <body>, the scrim is its ::backdrop. CSS that targeted a separate overlay element or the old portal container no longer matches; a rule written for the old overlay now paints the panel.

### `v2-bits-ui-dependency`

- **Before** (removed): bits-ui
- **After**: add bits-ui to your own dependencies if you import it
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: bits-ui is no longer installed with the package, and `ssr.noExternal` for it is not needed.

### `v2-bits-css-hooks`

- **Before** (removed): --bits-* variables, data-bits-* attributes
- **After**: --ca-anchor-width, --ca-accordion-height, --ca-collapsible-height, data-ca-day
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: Props, exported types, `ca-*` classes and `data-state` did not change; the `--bits-*` and `data-bits-*` hooks are gone.

### `v2-select-hidden-input`

- **Before** (removed): Select hidden <input> from bits-ui
- **After**: pass name to Select (4.0.0 renders a hidden input carrying the value)
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: `required` still blocks native form submit; a form that read the old hidden input must pass `name` on Select.

### `v2-setlocale-i18nprovider`

- **Before** (behavior): setLocale(x) in the root layout of an SSR app
- **After**: <I18nProvider locale={x}>…</I18nProvider>
- **migrate**: partial (`setlocale-to-i18nprovider`)
- **Why / notes**: `setLocale` is a no-op on the server (with a dev warning) because module state was shared across concurrent requests. The codemod only flags the call (file:line) since the layout markup has to be wrapped by hand; client-only apps keep `setLocale`.

### `v2-locale-open-set`

- **Before** (behavior): setLocale("en", fullOverride)
- **After**: registerLocale("es", dictionary) then locale="es"
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: `Locale` is a string now; a custom language is registered with a partial dictionary and falls back to English per key. `createErrorHandler()` takes `locale` for its fallback message.

## 1.0.0

Stable API, English strings, layered CSS, ThemeOptions.

### `v1-brandpreset-presetdefinition`

- **Before** (renamed): BrandPreset
- **After**: PresetDefinition ({ id, color, label? })
- **migrate**: yes (`brand-preset-to-preset-definition`)
- **Why / notes**: `BrandPreset` was removed from the exports. `brandPresetCSS` output changed (theme islands) and the head style id is `ca-theme` (was `ca-brand-presets`).

### `v1-themeoptions-partial-themedefinition`

- **Before** (behavior): ThemeOptions
- **After**: Partial<ThemeDefinition> from defineTheme()
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: `ThemeOptions` is now `Partial<ThemeDefinition>`. Move custom tokens into `overrides` and brand colors into `presets`; there is no mechanical rewrite.

### `v1-english-default-strings`

- **Before** (behavior): default UI strings (label, placeholder, confirmLabel, emptyText...)
- **After**: catalog strings; setLocale("pt-BR") once in the root layout
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: Defaults are English from a typed catalog (en, pt-BR). Portuguese apps call setLocale once; text props no longer have hardcoded defaults: omit them to use the catalog.

### `v1-layered-css`

- **Before** (behavior): global.css cascade
- **After**: @layer ca.reset, ca.tokens, ca.themes, ca.base, ca.components, ca.materials, ca.utilities
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: The kit CSS is layered, so unlayered app CSS wins without !important. Delete `!important` and doubled-class overrides you added to beat the kit. Override a token by declaring `--ca-*` on `:root`.

### `v1-page-background-and-opaque-chrome`

- **Before** (behavior): html / body background, MobileHeader, BottomNav
- **After**: html paints --ca-surface-base, mesh on body::before, opaque --ca-chrome-surface
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: `body` is transparent now. MobileHeader and BottomNav are opaque so the browser status bar and toolbar match them.

### `v1-autofocus-touch-and-responsive-undefined`

- **Before** (behavior): autofocus on touch, responsive store
- **After**: primeKeyboard() in the opening tap, or { touch: true }; responsive width is undefined until init()
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: `autofocus` on touch devices only focuses when the keyboard was primed in the opening tap. `responsive` has an undefined width until `init()` runs; derived values treat it as desktop.

### `v1-ios-safe-input-class-removed`

- **Before** (removed): .ca-input-ios-safe, .ca-app input rule
- **After**: nothing: every text field is 16px globally
- **migrate**: no
- **Why / notes**: Delete the class from your markup; the global 16px minimum covers every text field.
